# zerops_project_import (Resource)

Exclusively owns a whole project created from a sensitive YAML recipe. YAML or organization changes replace the entire project and destroy all its data, including user-added children. Do not co-manage this project with zerops_project or its service/settings resources. Refresh checks existence and service identities only, not YAML drift. The exact recipe is stored in state; secure state. Terraform import is unsupported because project export cannot recover the original recipe.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This resource owns the WHOLE project, including any user-added services/data.
# Changing YAML destroys/recreates the project. Do not co-manage its resources.
# YAML is sensitive and stored verbatim in Terraform state; secure your state.
# Refresh detects project existence/service IDs only, not recipe-content drift.
resource "zerops_project_import" "example" {
  yaml = <<-YAML
    project:
      name: imported-example
      corePackage: LIGHT
    services:
      - hostname: cache
        type: valkey:single@7.2
  YAML
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `yaml` (String, Sensitive) Immutable project creation recipe. Any change replaces the whole project; never reconciled from export.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider organization.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical project ID.
- `project_id` (String) Created project ID.
- `project_name` (String) Current project name.
- `services` (Map of String) Observed non-system service hostname to ID map. Missing children are not recreated.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
